result.title: Trace-to-Architecture: Capability Bottleneck Diagnosis for Harness Revision
result.summary: Improving an LLM agent requires knowing what to change when it fails. Similar failures can require different fixes, and resolving one problem can expose another. We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply. A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components, and then checks whether target tasks improve, selected successful tasks remain successful, and the edits are actually triggered. New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld, T2A achieves the highest aggregate score for all three evaluated task agents, exceeding their respective strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points. We also integrate T2A's diagnosis and validation procedures into Meta-Harness, improving the resulting harnesses' mean ScienceWorld score by 21.6 points from the same starting harness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Trace-to-Architecture（T2A）框架：用成功与失败任务的执行轨迹作为证据诊断 agent 的失败，修正 harness 组件，并迭代验证目标任务提升、已有成功任务不退化以及修改确实被触发，在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、AppWorld 上超过基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「执行证据定位失败→修改机制→验证改动实际触发」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中判断视觉或 latent 证据是否真正参与答案、以及贡献归因与监督设计提供可迁移线索，但仅属方法借鉴，尚需核查。
